Signature.purpose: One node of the pipeline diagram: a stage, the clock or Telegram
Signature.description: A stage shows its count; one with a queue adds an in-queue chip and a dead-letter chip that turns red when there are any. Pressing it selects it. The caption is cut at one line; the panel shows it whole.

button.class: w-full min-h-22 min-w-0 text-left rounded-box border px-3 py-2 flex flex-col gap-0.5 cursor-pointer transition-colors duration-150 motion-safe:active:scale-[0.98] {node.selected ? 'border-primary bg-base-200' : 'border-base-200 bg-base-100 hover:border-base-content/30'} {node.alert ? 'ring-1 ring-error/60' : ''}

span.class: badge badge-xs badge-ghost ml-auto shrink-0 gap-1
